scope: Weak normalized geometry sanity only. The LAM shaped mesh and Multiface tracked mesh are compared after independent bbox normalization, with no camera alignment, no scale recovery, and no held-out rendering. This can catch catastrophic shape/export failure but cannot support a quality claim.
